name: Soft build
summary: Calm, clean captions in front of the speaker. Each phrase is laid out once as a lead-in and a payoff, sometimes with a tail, and its words fill in place, settling in from the accent. One bar a video marks the payoff. No glow, pops or whip cuts.
use_when: a talking head where the words should read calm and clean, one thought at a time, with one payoff picked out
never_when: the words should sit behind the head, or the video needs loud, punchy words that slam and glow
